Messages.Author: Madzar
Messages.Body:
To use the card at Valeren superior to reduce the bleed against another Methuselah, you need to be unlocked, right?

Various wake effects don't help with this?

Name: Hide the Heart
[HttB:C/B2/PSal2]
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Valeren/Auspex
[aus] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[val] The action fails, unless the acting minion burns 1 blood. Only one Hide the Heart can be played at [val] each action.
[VAL] Reduce a bleed against you by 2, or lock to reduce a bleed against any Methuselah by 2.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Madzar wrote:
> To use the card at Valeren superior to reduce the bleed against another Methuselah, you need to be unlocked, right?
>
> Various wake effects don't help with this?
>
Correct. "Lock to X" makes locking the cost to pay for the effect X. If you are not unlocked, you cannot lock to pay a cost.
